newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil deputies to oversee CVRD's selloff.
newsitem.headline: Brazil deputies to oversee CVRD's selloff.

text.p: A committee of deputies is due to begin Wednesday viewing information on Brazil's soon-to-be privatized Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) in the Data Room, a BNDES spokeswoman said.
The committee, made up of seven deputies, was created last week to follow CVRD's privatization process, the spokeswoman for the National Development Bank (BNDES) said.
The lawmakers will have access to the same information available to investors, she added.

CVRD's selloff is expected to begin in March, but the Planning Ministry noted the auction of a 40-45 percent voting stake in the firm could be delayed until early April because of the high number of investors interested in collecting data on the company.
